input.self_check: I checked four other times (-20, -8, +8, +20 s) and two close-up crops. The head-to-head contact lasts at least about 30 s around the case time, which matches the tracker's 35% social votes. This could be wrong in two ways. The contact may be only brief sniffing, in which case the tracker's 'standing' label would win for most of the minute. Or the box may switch to a different cow after she turns, because the cows are bunched together and hard to tell apart. In the dim IR light I could not judge clinical signs.
